crossRefs.note: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand…
David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung all the chariot…
The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen…
The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore…
Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in…
Yahweh says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from Yahweh.
I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
“But as for us, Yahweh is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and…
The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.
Asa cried to Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has…
Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no might against this great company that comes against us. We don’t know…
An arm of flesh is with him, but Yahweh our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles.” The people rested…

translations.web: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
translations.bsb: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
translations.kjv: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
translations.asv: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses; But we will make mention of the name of Jehovah our God.
